description: Why would anyone join? Vic and Ron go deep on the people side of the Extropy Engine: the local DFAO rooms where neighbors and businesses coordinate, the network effect as the growth engine, and why more users means deeper discounts means more users. The movement is the ignition the math needs. Part 2 of The Engine in Plain Words.
